useful_god.rationale: Day Master Fire is strong; Earth balances the chart.

yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in the 12th sign from the Moon; Gaja-Kesari needs the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th.

yogas.name: Budha-Aditya
yogas.reason: Sun is in Aries and Mercury in Taurus; Budha-Aditya needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala
yogas.reason: Moon is in Aries and Mars in Aquarius; Chandra-Mangala needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Ruchaka
yogas.reason: Mars is in Aquarius, neither its own sign (Aries, Scorpio) nor its exaltation sign (Capricorn).

yogas.name: Bhadra
yogas.reason: Mercury is in Taurus, neither its own sign (Gemini, Virgo) nor its exaltation sign (Virgo).

yogas.name: Hamsa
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in its own sign Pisces and in the 1st house from the Lagna, a kendra.

yogas.name: Malavya
yogas.reason: Venus is in Gemini, neither its own sign (Taurus, Libra) nor its exaltation sign (Pisces).

yogas.name: Sasa
yogas.reason: Saturn is in Gemini, neither its own sign (Capricorn, Aquarius) nor its exaltation sign (Libra).

yogas.name: Harsha
yogas.reason: The 6th house is Leo; its lord Sun is in the 2nd house; Harsha needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Sarala
yogas.reason: The 8th house is Libra; its lord Venus is in the 4th house; Sarala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Vimala
yogas.reason: The 12th house is Aquarius; its lord Saturn is in the 4th house; Vimala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga
yogas.reason: No planet is in its debilitation sign.

yogas.name: Sunapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Taurus): Mercury; 12th from the Moon (Pisces): Jupiter (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Anapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Taurus): Mercury; 12th from the Moon (Pisces): Jupiter (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Durudhara
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Taurus): Mercury; 12th from the Moon (Pisces): Jupiter (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Kemadruma
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Taurus): Mercury; 12th from the Moon (Pisces): Jupiter (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count); Kemadruma means both are empty.

yogas.name: Vesi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Taurus): Mercury; 12th from the Sun (Pisces): Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Vasi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Taurus): Mercury; 12th from the Sun (Pisces): Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Taurus): Mercury; 12th from the Sun (Pisces): Jupiter (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Subha Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: none. Subha Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Papa Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in the 2nd house: Sun; in the 12th: Mars. Papa Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Parivartana
yogas.reason: Mercury is in Taurus (ruled by Venus) and Venus is in Gemini (ruled by Mercury).

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha
yogas.reason: Mars is 12th from the Lagna, 11th from the Moon and 9th from Venus; the dosha houses are the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th.

yogas.name: Kala Sarpa
yogas.reason: Planets lie on both sides of the Rahu–Ketu axis: Sun, Moon, Mars and Jupiter on one, Mercury, Venus and Saturn on the other.

yogas.name: Amala
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th from the Lagna (Sagittarius): none; in the 10th from the Moon (Capricorn): none.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: Lords of the 2nd, 5th, 9th and 11th (2nd Mars, 5th Moon, 9th Mars, 11th Saturn) share no sign, mutual aspect or sign exchange.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Mars (Aquarius) and the 10th lord Jupiter (Pisces) share no sign, mutual aspect or sign exchange.
